shared_elements: quadruped animal (in A) versus animal-like horned/curled features (in B)
schematic rendering of facial features (eyes, mouth)
justification: A is a multi-figure narrative relief on a flat arched panel with a border of zigzag/chevron framing, showing standing armed human figures above a large horned quadruped and a snake-like creature; B is a single sculpted head in the round with curled horn-like or coiled hair masses over the ears and a bared, grid-like row of teeth. The only shared content is the generic presence of anthropomorphic faces and horned/animal attributes, rendered schematically in both, but there is no shared scene, no comparable relationship between elements, and no comparable arrangement (a bordered narrative field versus a three-dimensional isolated head).
